Self-initiated concept / 2026

The challenge

Translate the calm of physical space into a screen without losing its warmth.

The strategy

Let the architecture lead. A restrained navigation system and generous visual rhythm make every space feel worth exploring.

Development

A responsive editorial system with carefully sized photography, keyboard navigation, and motion that supports the reading pace.

Motion

Restrained image reveals, tactile hover states, and a deliberate reading rhythm. A still experience remains available for visitors who prefer reduced motion.
